description: This file contains functions related to firmware upgrade and boot management for Linksys devices, including obtaining target firmware, checking factory images, performing the upgrade process, and handling partition selection for eMMC and SPI flash devices.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition for upgrade based on current boot environment and UBI settings.

methods.name: linksys_is_factory_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided firmware image matches the device's footer signature to verify it as a factory image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade process for Linksys devices using raw image files, handling different magic numbers and UBI options.

methods.name: linksys_get_cmdline_rootfs_device
methods.description: Extracts the root filesystem device parameter from kernel command line.

methods.name: linksys_get_current_boot_part_emmc
methods.description: Determines current boot partition in eMMC devices via environment variables or kernel command line.

methods.name: linksys_set_target_partitions_emmc
methods.description: Sets target boot and root partitions in eMMC devices by updating environment variables based on current boot partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys_emmc
methods.description: Handles upgrade process for eMMC devices, including partition switching and invoking eMMC upgrade commands.
